commit.message:
KS-1278: revoke decides already-revoked in the UPDATE, not only on the read

Refs KS-1278

POST /api/documents/:id/revoke decided "already revoked" on a READ
(routes/documents.ts:2374) and then ran an unconditional UPDATE, so two overlapping
revokes could both pass that read: 200 + 200, two updates, two action_provenance
rows and two anchor calls. updateDocument now takes an ifStatusIsNot option that
adds the guard to the WHERE, and a guarded write that changed no row returns null.
The loser answers the same 400 and returns before recordOnBehalfOf, so it records
nothing and anchors nothing. The row-lock alternative is not taken.

Red-first: with both test sections and neither product hunk the cell file is rc 1,
2 failed / 2 passed of 4 executed - R1 and R2 red, C1 and C2 green. Four executed,
so an assertion red and not a load failure.

One tamper per conjunct, each applied alone: the clause deleted, and IS DISTINCT
FROM inverted to =, both redden R2; removing the guardStatus not-null term reddens
C2; affected === 0 changed to === -1 reddens R1. So C2 is the only arm guarding the
pass-through for callers that ask for no guard.

originate unit suite 90 suites / 1063 tests to 91 / 1067, 0 failed at both ends.
tsc rc 0. Measured 2026-10-05, host Kamil Mac Studio (2), node v24.7.0, jest 29.7.0.

Both platform-k documents carry a new block: flow 15. between 14. and 19., cheat
sheet a new last section, per the ruling. No stated timing row is amended and no
Akto tier budget moves; 0 stated timings cover an originate unit suite (must-hit
controls auth 76/75 and Akto 71/83).

NOT COVERED: no live sweep (skill 5f), so KS-1278 does not move to Done on this
change account. The cells mock the Prisma driver, so atomicity is pinned at the SQL
text level plus the JS return path; that two concurrent transactions really
serialise on this WHERE is UNMEASURED. A document deleted between the read and the
guarded write answers 400 where 404 belongs - pre-existing, narrowed to a race
window here, not introduced by it.

KS-1278: key the guarded revoke UPDATE on the row the read resolved, not external_id

Refs KS-1278

The guarded UPDATE this branch added in round 1 decided already-revoked IN the statement, which
is what KS-1278 asked for, but it still keyed on external_id. Both reads fall back to the primary
key for a UUID-shaped id (documentRepo.ts:244-251) and the API hands clients that key as
documentUuid (:172), so a SEQUENTIAL, non-race revoke of a live, owned, unrevoked document
addressed by its documentUuid matched 0 rows, the guarded write returned null, and the route
answered 400 Document
is
already
revoked for a document nobody had revoked. That is gate65
N-1393-1, and it is PROBED, not argued.

The guarded write now keys on the row the read resolved (:616): a COALESCE of two tenant-scoped
scalar subqueries, external_id first and then the primary key, which is the read's own precedence
rather than a new rule. The status guard stays in the same statement, so of two overlapping
writers exactly one still changes the row.

NARROWED ON PURPOSE. Only the one opted-in caller changes key. 12 of the 13 production
updateDocument( callers pass no ifStatusIsNot and take a byte-identical statement, proved by cell
N3. The census that establishes 13 production callers, 1 opted in, 12 others is on KS 1424, filed
for the pre-existing class: for an unguarded caller a UUID-addressed update matches 0 rows and
reports success. That is NOT fixed here. The census also corrects the figure of 14 used while
ruling this fix; 14 counted the 13 calls plus one non-call line.

A non-UUID external id never reaches the ::uuid cast, which would otherwise raise 22P02. The
resolver binds null instead of casting, mirroring the isValidUuid guard the read already uses at
:244. Cell N2 pins it and is green at both ends.

Red-first, by assertion, at 4a1620588819: 1 failed / 6 passed of 7 EXECUTED. Only N1 is red; R1
and R2 are green at that baseline because it already carries round 1 guard, so only the KEY was
wrong. Seven executed, and both new controls are green, so the single red discriminates rather
than being a blanket failure. At this head: 7 passed of 7.

originate unit suite, same binary both ends: 91 suites / 1070 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped, against
91 / 1067 at round 1. Delta +3 tests, +0 suites, exactly the three new cells in the same file.
12.174 s, measured 2026-10-05 22:24:34-22:24:47Z on Kamil Mac Studio (2), node v24.7.0, jest
29.7.0. tsc -p services/originate --noEmit rc 0, and documentRepo.ts IS in that program (checked
with --listFilesOnly first); a planted TS2322 on the new declaration gives rc 2, restored
byte-identical. The tsconfig still excludes src/__tests__, so the CELL FILE is type-unchecked:
NOT RUN, not coverage.

R1 and R2 were strengthened per N-1393-2. R1 now also asserts 0 anchor emissions on the losing
path, counted from the POST /api/anchors that emitLifecycleAnchor makes (documents.ts:1261; it is
module-local and cannot be mocked). R2 now asserts the VALUE bound after IS DISTINCT FROM, not
only that the SQL text carries the clause.

N1 could have passed vacuously and does not. A driver stubbed to a constant 1 is green at both
ends and a constant 0 is red at both, so the cell simulates what Postgres would answer for one
fixture row, and THROWS if the UPDATE keys on neither shape it knows.

Both platform-k documents are updated in this same commit. The flow block 15. paragraph no longer
claims a null can only mean the row became revoked in between; it names each meaning of null with
its instrument. Each document minus its own block is byte-identical to 4a1620588819.

NOT COVERED: no live sweep (skill 5f), so KS-1278 does not move to Done on this change's account.
The cells mock the Prisma driver, so that two concurrent transactions really serialise on this
WHERE is UNMEASURED. The round-2 tamper matrix was NOT RUN: round 1 T1-T4 still map as recorded,
but G7, G8, K1 and T5 re-checked against R2 new assertion were not executed, so whether R2 now
catches the declared-blind T5 is UNMEASURED. A document deleted inside the revoke window still
answers 400 where 404 belongs, unchanged, tracked as KS 1419. The four platform suites
(Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright, k6) were NOT run.

KS-1278: pin the revoke guard by exact clause text and its own bound parameters

Refs KS-1278

A follow-up to 97ce2f337ae6 on the same branch. No product change: documentRepo.ts is untouched by
this commit. What changes is the strength of the cell that pins the guard, and the two documents
that describe it.

R2 asserted that the UPDATE's SQL contained 'status IS DISTINCT FROM' and that its bound values
CONTAINED 'revoked'. Both halves were too weak, and the round-2 tamper matrix is what showed it.
T5 prefixes TRUE OR to the guard clause, which makes the guard vacuous and leaves that substring
intact. G7 sets ifStatusIsNot to 'draft', and membership still passed because this UPDATE binds
'revoked' THREE times: the SET clause's new status at index 1, and the guard at 9 and 10.
Measured with a throwaway probe cell, not reasoned from the source.

R2 now pins the guard clause by EXACT text, so a prefix breaks it, and the guard's own two
parameters BY POSITION. slice(-2) is used rather than the literal indices, because the guard is
the final clause in every variant of this statement while a changed SET list would shift a
literal index.

Matrix at this head, each tamper alone, both product files restored and sha256-verified after
every row: G7 -> R2, G8 -> R1, K1 -> R1278 N1, T5 -> R2. FOUR of four caught, against two of four
at 97ce2f337ae6. Round 1's T1-T4 are unchanged and still map as recorded.

K1 needs its dead declaration removed in the same tamper or it measures nothing: reverting the key
alone leaves idAsUuid unused, ts-jest refuses the file, and the suite reports 0 total and 0
executed with no cell red AND no cell green. A load failure is not an inert tamper and only the
executed count separates them.

originate unit suite, same binary: 91 suites / 1070 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped - unchanged from
97ce2f337ae6, because no cell was added. 10.163 s, measured 2026-10-05 22:57:18-22:57:28Z on
Kamil Mac Studio (2), node v24.7.0, jest 29.7.0. tsc -p services/originate --noEmit rc 0.
The cell file remains type-unchecked: that tsconfig excludes src/__tests__.

Both platform-k documents are corrected in this same commit. The cheat sheet row that claimed R2
asserted the bound value is replaced, and it says so rather than quietly reading differently; its
tamper row moves from NOT RUN to 4 of 4 with a row for the load-failure distinction. The flow
block 15. names the guard's instrument beside R1's. Each document minus its own KS-1278 block is
byte-identical to 97ce2f337ae6, one diff region each.

NOT COVERED: unchanged by this commit. No live sweep (skill 5f), so KS-1278 does not move to Done
on this change's account. The driver is mocked, so serialisation on this WHERE is UNMEASURED. The
four platform suites were NOT run. KS 1419 is unchanged, and KS 1424 carries the pre-existing
class for the twelve unguarded callers.
